question_en:
I am the mobile catalog editor for the Community Cinema and need to determine whether movie posters are suitable for enabling the 'Multi-Face Safe Crop' feature. Please limit the scope to films officially released between 2006 and 2022 in the official Blender Studio Films catalog. Please answer:

Review the official main poster image used for each film in this catalog. Which posters show at least two distinct and clear character faces simultaneously? Each face must allow identification of the eye area and the mouth/nose area. Silhouettes, back views, extremely small group shots where facial details are unidentifiable, and posters with only one clear face do not meet the criteria. Posters meeting the criteria are judged as 'Enable'; others are judged as 'Do Not Enable'. Please provide a complete list covering all films within this scope, stating the film name, release year, and judgment for each row. Then, list all films judged as 'Enable' along with the total count.

The answer must include a complete itemized table of 'Film Name—Release Year—Judgment', followed by a Q&A section listing all enabled films and their count.
answer:

| Hero | 2018 | Do Not Enable |
| The Daily Dweebs | 2017 | Do Not Enable |
| Agent 327 | 2017 | Enable |
| Caminandes: Llamigos | 2016 | Enable |
| Glass Half | 2015 | Enable |
| Cosmos Laundromat: First Cycle | 2015 | Do Not Enable |
| Caminandes: Gran Dillama | 2013 | Do Not Enable |
| Tears of Steel | 2012 | Do Not Enable |
| Sintel | 2010 | Enable |
| Big Buck Bunny | 2008 | Enable |
| Elephants Dream | 2006 | Enable |

Q: Which films are judged as 'Enable' in total, and how many are there?

A: Charge, Sprite Fright, Agent 327, Caminandes: Llamigos, Glass Half, Sintel, Big Buck Bunny, Elephants Dream; total 8 films.
